products.product_id: Unique product identifier; primary key for product dimension
products.category: Product classification/taxonomy (Electronics, Apparel, Home & Kitchen, Sport, Sports)
products.standard_price: Reference/list price for the product; basis for pricing decisions

sales_data.transaction_id: Unique transaction/order identifier; null in 4.3% of records; contains both TXN and RET prefixes (TXN=sale, RET=return)
sales_data.transaction_date: Date of transaction in mixed formats (MM/DD/YYYY and YYYY-MM-DD); spans Jan-Mar 2024
sales_data.store_id: Foreign key reference to stores.store_id; null in 2.69% of records indicating online/unattributed sales
sales_data.product_id: Foreign key reference to products.product_id; 100% populated across all 20 products
sales_data.product_name: Denormalized product name; should match products table for consistency validation
sales_data.category: Denormalized product category; 21 unique values suggest case-sensitivity inconsistencies with products table
sales_data.quantity: Number of units sold/returned per transaction; ranges -4 to +8 (negative=returns); mean 3.94 units
sales_data.unit_price: Actual price charged per unit in transaction; may differ from standard_price due to promotions/discounts; wide range $0.01–$9999.99
sales_data.total_amount: Derived total = quantity × unit_price; negative values indicate return transactions with credit amounts
sales_data.customer_segment: Customer classification (Loyal, Premium, etc.); 16 unique values suggesting undocumented segment types or data quality issues
sales_data.payment_method: Payment instrument used (Apple Pay, PayPal, etc.); 4 unique methods; important for settlement tracking

stores.store_id: Unique store identifier; primary key for store dimension; fully populated (no nulls)
stores.region: Geographic region grouping (Northeast, Southeast, etc.); 4 unique regions
stores.city: City where store is located; 10 unique cities with 1:1 mapping to store_id
stores.state: US state abbreviation (NY, MA, PA, GA, FL, etc.); 9 unique states

join_keys.notes: 100% foreign key coverage; 20 unique products in both tables; enables product enrichment (standard_price, clean category)
90% FK coverage; 5 nulls (2.69%) indicating online/unattributed sales; 10 unique stores fully represented in dimension

HIGH: store_id has 5 nulls (2.69%) suggesting online sales or data collection gaps; requires flag column for unknown/online vs. brick-and-mortar attribution
HIGH: transaction_date in mixed formats (MM/DD/YYYY vs YYYY-MM-DD); must standardize to ISO 8601 format during Bronze transformation
HIGH: Category field mismatch between products (5 categories) and sales_data (21 categories); case sensitivity ('Sport' vs 'Sports') indicates denormalization drift or data entry errors
MEDIUM: quantity contains negative values (min -4) representing returns/reversals; recommend flag column separating sales (qty>0) from returns (qty<0)
MEDIUM: unit_price outliers observed ($0.01 and $9999.99); verify if outliers are legitimate transactions or data entry errors; wide variance (mean $356.27) suggests dynamic pricing
MEDIUM: customer_segment shows 16 unique values (e.g., Loyal, Premium) suggesting undocumented segment types or data quality issues; recommend domain validation
MEDIUM: total_amount contains negative values (-$1230.56 min) consistent with return transactions; sign convention is correct but impacts sum-based metrics
LOW: products.product_id (20 rows) and sales_data.product_id (20 unique) indicate complete product coverage with no orphaned products; good referential integrity
